subject.why: The dock, pirate flag, rope coil, and mooring posts are clearly depicted.

category.why: The structure rests naturally in clear water with a low, heroic viewpoint.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, characters, or watermarks are present.

framing.why: The dock cuts off abruptly on the left edge, lacking the required side margins.

colour.why: Bright, saturated palette with clear contrast between the wood and blue background.

detail.why: Shapes are simple and chunky without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth stylized volumes and satin lighting match the references.

fix: Zoom out slightly to keep the entire dock contained within the frame with clear side margins.
